question: In the sustainable slogan "Reduce, Reuse, Recycle," which action is considered the most effective for protecting the environment?
What happens if you put non-recyclable items (like a greasy pizza box or a plastic bag) into a recycling bin?
options: A) The recycling center workers will just wash it for you.
B) It can contaminate the entire batch of recycling, causing the whole load to be sent to a landfill.
C) It gets turned into a lower quality of plastic.
D) It disappears during the melting process.
answer: B) It can contaminate the entire batch of recycling, causing the whole load to be sent to a landfill.

question: Does a microwave or a coffee maker use electricity when the clock is on but the machine is not cooking or brewing?
options: A) No, electricity only flows when the "Start" button is pressed.
B) Yes, these are called "Phantom Loads" and can cost money every month.
C) Only if the room lights are also on
answer: B) Yes, these are called "Phantom Loads" and can cost money every month.

question: Most plastic containers have a small triangle with a number (1 through 7) on the bottom. What is the most important thing this number tells you?
options: A) How many times the bottle has already been recycled.
B) The grade of plastic (chemical resin type), which determines if your local center can actually recycle it.
C) How much liquid the bottle can hold
D) The thickness of the plastic walls.
answer: B) The grade of plastic (chemical resin type), which determines if your local center can actually recycle it.
